$comment: Descriptive, derived from the types the bounded parser reads; the parser is the only authority on validity. Where the parser reads two versions of a document with one type, this schema admits what that type admits, including members the later version adds. Byte, depth and count bounds are recorded in x-rustev-parse-limits (a string length here counts characters, the parser counts bytes), and rules applied when a plan is compiled are stated in field descriptions, not enforced here.

value.description: An acquisition page or runtime reason, subject to retention.

CaptureStatus.description: Whether every supplied value was captured. Only `complete` reproduces.

oneOf.description: The byte or request cap was hit; captured payloads were discarded.

Retention.description: How the bytes were kept. Every mode has an expiry.

oneOf.description: The record canonical document, embedded as a JSON UTF-8 string.
An opaque host reference; never an instruction to fetch a URL.
Only the digest: always `missing` at replay.

RetentionItem.description: One retained document, as the host declares it.

document_schema.description: The schema string the document must carry.

identity.description: The document's identity, where its schema defines one.

Scope.description: The isolation scope of a capture, a bundle and every request identity.

oneOf.description:
Reuse across principals within one tenant and context revision: an
explicit host assertion that the computation is principal-independent
and that the host authorizes every reader (spec 004, 3.1.4).

Reuse only within one tenant, context revision and effective
principal scope. The default.

SupplyEntry.description: One value successfully supplied to the core.

attempt_id.description:
The attempt that produced the value (spec 004, 3.2); none when
nothing was dispatched or a retry or fallback followed the last one.

request.description:
The identity of the request for the producing target (spec 004, 3.2);
the document is recomputed from the retained plan and snapshot.

target.description:
The target the value came from (0 is the primary, then declared
fallbacks): the producing target of an output; for a failure, the `to`
of the last fallback transition, else 0.

acquisition_pages.description: Replay 2: captured pages share the semantic supply sequence.

calibrations.description: Every calibration artifact the plan binds.

created_at_ms.description: Host wall-clock times; copying a bundle resets neither.

descriptors.description: Every descriptor the plan's bindings name.

evaluation_time_ms.description: The domain time the decision was evaluated at.

run.description: The delivered `rustev.run/1` record; the expected judgment is in it.

sources.description: Replay 2: the source descriptors bound by the retained plan.
